card.name: Start of a name or heading word
card.fires_on: The first piece of a capitalized word that is split into parts, such as a surname, company name, or a heading right after '5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS'. Also the digit 9 in the ZIP+4 code of the MedWatch address.

modes.label: Split surnames and company names
modes.description: The opening piece of a person or company name that continues in the next piece.
modes.example: J Cancer, 2011. 106 (S2) p. S14- S18. PubMed -<< Cor>>rao, G., et al.,

modes.label: Warnings section headings
modes.description: The first piece of the heading word that comes right after the section title 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS.
modes.example: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS<< Ex>>acerbation of Liver Impairment:

modes.label: MedWatch ZIP code digit
modes.description: The digit 9 inside the ZIP+4 code of the FDA MedWatch address.
modes.example: MEDWATCH, Food and Drug Administration (FDA), 5600 Fishers Lane, Rockville, MD 20852-<<9>>782. Telephone: (8
